title: Tensor product of a finite separable field with an algebraic closure
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $k'/k$ be a finite separable field extension [def-pc-field-extension] [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension], and let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field containing $k$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Then the $\Omega$-algebra $k'\otimes_k\Omega$ is isomorphic to $\prod_{\sigma:k'\hookrightarrow_k\Omega}\Omega$, with one factor for each $k$-embedding $\sigma:k'\hookrightarrow\Omega$; in particular it is a product of $[k':k]$ copies of $\Omega$ [def-pc-field-tower].
